children.name: DS.03 · Patterns & feedback
children.context: Shared feedback patterns. Placement follows the scope affected: collection-wide feedback centered in the complete results region; local failures confined to their pane; field and save errors inside the form; refresh failures above retained data. Empty is a successful request with zero records and must never represent loading, failed requests or denied access.

children.name: Intro
children.content: Table behavior, contextual actions and clear feedback. The same system, from first load to completion.

children.name: Feedback / empty
children.context: Successful search/filter query with zero matches. Center in the full results region and keep query controls available. Use the filter recovery component for targeted removal of a restrictive criterion. For an unfiltered first-use collection, change the title and action to No geofences yet / Create geofence. Never use a zero-results state for loading, failed requests or denied access.

children.name: Message
children.content: Try a different name or clear the filters.

children.name: Feedback / error
children.context: Request failure state. Center in the whole results region when no usable collection data is available; center only inside the affected pane for a map/inspector failure. Keep query controls and offer Retry. Never display a zero result count for a failed request. If refreshing the same query fails after data was loaded, retain that data with a stale banner instead of replacing it with this state.

children.name: Message
children.content: Try again to load your results.

children.name: Feedback / loading
children.context: Initial loading uses skeletons in the results region; do not flash the empty state. Background refresh keeps same-query content visible with a progress indication. Loading, zero results, request failure and denied access are distinct states.

children.name: Deactivate geofence
children.context: Active records: Deactivate opens impact confirmation. Draft and inactive records: use Activate after validation. No Archive status exists.

children.name: Permission notice
children.content: View-only access. Ask your workspace admin for permission to edit geofences.

children.name: Whole results → center explanation
children.content: No matches, initial load failure or no access. Keep page controls; use a state-specific recovery action.

children.name: One pane → inside that pane
children.context: Local pane failure: keep unaffected content and retry only that pane. A map viewport without visible features is not a query failure; show Fit results locally when the collection has records outside the viewport.

children.name: One pane → inside that pane label
One pane → inside that pane explanation
children.content: A map or inspector failure stays local. Keep unaffected results available. Retry only the failed area.

children.name: Form → field or form notice label
Form → field or form notice explanation
children.content: Validation sits beside its field. Save failures persist near the form actions and preserve entered values.

children.name: Refresh → banner above data explanation
children.content: Keep same-query data with a stale label and Retry. Background job failures remain in notifications and history.

children.name: Library summary
children.content: Composable cells, predictable behavior, and a consistent foundation for Geofences, People, and Live operations.

children.content: Every specimen below is a reusable cell. Values are illustrative; formats carry across table contexts.

children.name: Value
children.content: Nhava Sheva International Container Terminal — North Gate / Export Operations

children.name: Formatting guidance
children.content: Text aligns left; quantities align right. Missing values use an em dash. Restricted data remains explicit. Status always has a text label.

children.name: 02  /  Header anatomy description
children.content: One shared header cell with explicit sort, menu, pin, focus, and resize states.

children.name: Header behavior
children.content: Sort by the label. Open the menu for secondary actions. Drag a boundary to resize; double-click to fit. Pins remain visible in the header.

children.name: 03  /  Composed Geofence rows description
children.content: Shared column widths keep headers and body aligned. Selection and name stay pinned on the left; row actions stay on the right.

children.name: Row behavior
children.content: 76 px comfortable rows support a second line; 52 px compact rows emphasize primary values. Names open details; checkboxes change selection independently.

children.name: 04  /  Table controls description
children.content: Toolbar, contextual bulk actions, and pagination are independent components shared by every table.

children.name: Filters
children.context: Opens the full-height filter drawer from the right. Count equals the number of applied filter predicates.

children.name: Selection scope
children.content: Selection persists across pages within the current result set. The count is explicit. Changing filters clears selection; selecting all results requires the separate link.

children.name: Composable structure detail
children.content: Table → row → cell → content. Reuse cells and override values; keep one width definition per column.

children.name: Content behavior detail
children.content: Wrap names to two lines in comfortable density. Truncate overflow with a full-value tooltip. Keep numbers and units together.

children.name: View preferences detail
children.content: Persist visibility, order, widths, pins, sort, and density per saved view. A modified view exposes Save and Reset.

children.name: Interaction title
children.content: A table that adapts to the work.

children.name: Interaction summary
children.content: Visual states and behavior contracts for column customization, selection, keyboard access, and resilient data loading.

children.name: 01  /  Column customization description
children.content: The column chooser manages the whole view; each header menu provides local control.

children.name: Visible count
children.content: 7 of 14 columns shown · drag to reorder

children.name: Chooser behavior
children.content: Changes preview immediately. Name is required and pinned. Selection and actions are always available. Save the view to keep the configuration.

children.name: Header menu availability
children.content: Disable unavailable moves at pinned boundaries. Show Unpin only for pinned columns; disable Clear sort when no sort is active.

children.name: Keyboard details
children.content: Tab to headers and controls. Enter sorts; Space toggles selection. Open the header menu for Move left/right and Set width. Escape closes a menu and restores focus.

children.name: Resize behavior
children.content: The guide follows the full column. Resize updates header and every cell together. Clamp to the minimum; double-click fits content.

children.name: Reorder behavior
children.content: Drag the header or its grip in Columns. The insertion marker shows the destination. Drop commits; Escape cancels. Pinned groups keep their boundaries.

children.name: Persisted properties
children.content: Column order, widths, visibility, pins, sorting, and density are saved together.

children.name: 02  /  Selection without ambiguity description
children.content: Distinguish row selection, current-page selection, and all matching results.

children.name: Scope detail
children.content: Header selects the current page. Row click opens details; it does not select.

children.name: Scope detail
children.content: Mixed header state. Bulk actions act only on the selected identifiers.

children.name: Scope detail
children.content: Offer “Select all 142 matching results” as a separate, explicit action.

children.name: Bulk action rules
children.content: Keep the selected count visible across pages. Disabled actions explain eligibility. After a filter change, clear selection and announce it. A destructive action names its exact scope.

children.name: 03  /  Horizontal overflow & pinning description
children.content: A scrolled view keeps identity and row actions anchored while optional data moves between them.

children.name: Overflow behavior
children.content: Use one horizontal scroll position for header and body. Preserve focus while scrolling. Pinned-column separators remain visible; changing widths never detaches labels from values.

children.name: 04  /  Data lifecycle states description
children.content: Preserve the table structure and offer a specific recovery action for each state.

children.name: Library introduction
children.content: Composable controls and table cells for fast triage. Every row has one clear next action.

children.content: Use text + color for urgency. Preserve the last refresh time when offline.

children.content: Asset first. Driver and site details stay secondary. Issue context wraps inside its own column.

children.name: Interaction guidance

children.name: DS.09 · Shared data workflows
children.context: Shared platform data patterns. Contextual Import and Export dialogs preserve the originating module state. Reusable modal components are in DS.10. Filters remain a full-height contextual drawer. Transfer history is a persistent page for drafts, background jobs and recovery. Module configuration supplies schema, capabilities and permissions.

children.name: System summary
children.content: One interaction system for every module. Contextual dialogs for Import and Export, a consistent drawer for query changes, and a durable history for background jobs.

children.name: Commit status
children.content: No records change until you confirm the import.

children.name: Platform / Filter drawer header
children.context: Shared header for Basic and Advanced filters. The mode bar immediately below is stable in both modes. Close, Cancel and Escape discard the pending query and retain the previously applied filters.

children.name: Platform / Filter drawer footer
children.context: Canonical footer. Reset filters clears pending Status and all condition groups, preserving page search and global scope; Cancel restores the applied query. Apply depends only on a changed, valid draft, not the optional result estimate. Debounce estimates, associate responses with a query revision, and discard older responses. Announce count updates politely without moving focus. Zero results is valid; failure is Preview unavailable.

children.name: Platform / Import export trigger
children.context: Stable app-wide Import/export trigger. Menu opens the relevant contextual modal over the current module. Import and Export share dialog chrome, cancel behavior, permissions and return-to-context. Transfer history remains available for background work and resumable drafts.

children.name: Platform / Transfer menu
children.context: Shared menu. Import opens the contextual import dialog; Export opens contextual export. Permission-denied actions remain visible with an explanation. Transfer history opens persistent drafts/jobs across allowed modules.

children.name: Entry availability
children.content: Same placement in every module. Import and export availability follows module capabilities and user access; each job is scoped to its source module.

children.name: Filter / Condition row
children.context: Field / Operator / Typed value. Status is a scope constraint outside these groups. Operators and the value slot are supplied by field type. Rows grow for wrapped values. Remove affects one condition. Field changes clear incompatible operator/value only with visible feedback.

children.name: DS.10 · Contextual transfer dialogs
children.context: Shared contextual transfer shell. 1120 px import dialog for spatial preview and mapping; 900 px compact export dialog. Adapt to smaller viewports with one internally scrolling body and persistent heading/actions. Trap focus, restore trigger focus, announce validation, and prevent accidental backdrop dismissal. Changed forms support Save draft or Discard; running jobs remain durable after closing.

children.name: Shared dialog chrome and transfer feedback
Dialog description
children.content: Add boundaries or a reference layout to Mundra Port.

children.name: Close dialog
children.context: Close returns focus to the trigger. If file or settings changed, offer Save draft or Discard. Never close on an outside click.

children.name: Commit reassurance
children.content: Nothing is added until you confirm.

children.name: Platform / Transfer notification
children.context: One in-context notification pattern for importing, exporting, completed with download, partial success, and failure. Running progress never traps the user in a modal. Transfer history owns durable details and retry. Completion message includes exclusions. Dismiss does not cancel the job.

children.name: Layout import completion detail
children.content: 8 geofences · KML. You can keep working.

children.name: Modal interaction contract
children.content: Import and Export stay over the originating module. The shell, close behavior, permissions, progress feedback and return path are shared; each module configures file types, fields and validation. Reference layouts are map layers. Boundaries become draft geofences only after explicit review.

children.name: DS.11 · Filter system and interaction contract
children.context: Canonical 640 px panel; 14 px controls in both modes. Basic ANDs fields. Advanced combines non-status fields with groups. Status, page search and global scope remain AND constraints outside groups. Typed controls and all field states live in DS.12 PtgwA.

children.name: Filter modes description
children.content: Orient → narrow → preview → apply → refine → reuse. The drawer is one part of a controlled query component.

children.name: Platform / Filter mode switcher
children.context: Basic is the initial mode for new and representable queries. Both modes edit the same pending query; switching never applies or clears it. Existing complex queries open in Advanced. All module fields/operators are schema configured.

children.name: Platform / Complex filter query notice
children.context: Shown in place of Basic controls only when the draft contains logic Basic cannot represent. Do not hide active rules, drop clauses, or silently simplify. Edit advanced rules returns to Advanced. Reset to Basic explicitly clears the draft filters; applied results are unchanged until Apply. Cancel restores the applied query.

children.name: Complex query explanation
children.content: These filters use groups or operators that Basic cannot represent. Continue in Advanced, or reset the draft filters.

children.name: Platform / Status filter
children.context: Single status scope shared with the page tabs. Always AND with the editable condition groups. All means unrestricted. Apply synchronizes page and panel; Cancel restores the applied value. Use a searchable single-select when options/labels exceed the segmented layout.

children.name: Field / Multi-select
children.context: Searchable multi-select. Selected values match OR within this field. Closing picker keeps draft choices. Summary shows up to two values when they fit, otherwise first value + additional count; labels can wrap. Opening reveals every selected value. Clear means unrestricted.

children.name: Role selection guidance
children.content: People can match either selected role.

children.name: Platform / Filter combination
children.context: Combine only the conditions inside this group. Global tenant/site, page search and Status always constrain the result with AND outside the group. Different fields may use All / Any; multi-values within one field use OR. Neutral values create no clause. Empty group is removed.

children.name: One query rule detail
children.content: Global scope, search and Status are AND constraints. Basic ANDs fields; Advanced combines non-status conditions in All / Any groups. Multi-values within a field use OR; neutral values add no clause.

children.name: Safe switching rule detail
children.content: Switch modes losslessly for supported operators, multi-values and ranges. Cross-field OR or unsupported logic opens the Advanced guard; reset changes only the draft.

children.name: One commit rule detail
children.content: Apply filters commits the draft across views. Cancel, close and Escape discard pending edits. Switching modes never applies. Unchanged drafts have a disabled Apply action.

children.name: Clear scope rule detail
children.content: Search, tenant and global site scope remain page context. Status is one filter value shared with page tabs. Apply synchronizes both controls; Reset clears field filters, including status.

children.name: Consistent counting rule detail
children.content: Count normalized active criteria: multi-value = 1, range = 1, neutral = 0. Group totals count their conditions. Status counts once; global scope and search do not count. Badge shows applied criteria; preview shows draft matches.

children.name: Module configuration rule detail
children.content: Module configuration supplies visible fields, labels, option sources, date presets, ranges and allowed advanced operators. The panel shell and query behavior remain shared.

children.name: Platform / Applied filter summary
children.context: Shows all applied field criteria below the fixed header; a restricted status is included and synchronized with the status tabs. Each chip opens its field; X removes that criterion with Undo. Clear filters resets field criteria and status to All, retaining search and global scope. Save view stores the query independently of List/Map/Split rendering. Cross-field OR groups remain explicit atomic groups rather than misleading flat chips.

children.name: Platform / Filter value picker
children.context: Field-level overlay inside the editor, with no second Apply. Choosing an option changes only the draft and recalculates preview. Search narrows options only. Values are permission scoped; dependent fields expose invalid selections explicitly. Keyboard arrows navigate, Space toggles, Escape closes this picker before the drawer. Module supplies values and optional facet counts.

children.name: Typed field states and component interface
Inputs details
children.content: Page context • applied query • field schema • permissions • result preview.

children.name: Outputs details
children.content: Draft changed • apply • cancel • remove criterion • clear extra filters • save view.

children.name: Typed controls details
children.content: Enum → searchable choices. Relationship → scoped lookup. Date → presets and range. Number → min / max with units. Boolean → named choices.

children.name: Field feedback details
children.content: Loading choices, no matching options, unavailable values and invalid ranges keep the current selection and explain the next action.

children.name: Result feedback details
children.content: Initial failure and zero results use different centered states. Pane failures stay local; validation stays by its field. Failed refreshes keep same-query data with a stale banner. See DS.03 for placement.

children.name: Platform / Filter no-results
children.context: Successful zero-result response only. Center in the full results region below persistent page controls, regardless of List, Map or Split. Do not confine this collection-wide state to the list pane. Neutral icon, concise message and relevant recovery actions. Keep filters and view choice. First-use empty, loading, unavailable data and permission denial use different states.

children.name: Recovery explanation
children.content: Try removing the area limit to broaden these results.

children.name: 08 / Checking the draft footer
children.context: Optional count is checking. A changed valid draft remains applicable. Keep inputs editable, preserve the last applied results, and ignore responses for older drafts.

children.name: 09 / Invalid field value footer
children.context: Minimum area exceeds maximum. Keep both typed values, mark the area field with the same inline message, link this summary to that field and disable commit. Cancel still restores applied state.

children.name: 10 / Preview unavailable footer
children.context: Only the optional count preview failed; the draft is valid. Retry rechecks the preview. Apply filters still submits the query and lets the results surface handle success or failure. Never report zero for a failed request.
